articles.headline: Vanderbilt PG Tyler Tanner withdraws from NBA draft
articles.description: Vanderbilt's Tyler Tanner, one of the elite point guards in the country, told ESPN on Wednesday that he has withdrawn from the NBA draft and will return for his junior season.

articles.headline: Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA draft, set for college return
articles.description: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1 player in the transfer portal, is withdrawing from the NBA draft and will play college basketball next season, his agents told ESPN.

article.story: ANN ARBOR, Mich. -- — Morez Johnson Jr. had 24 points and 11 rebounds to lead No. 2 Michigan to a 112-71 victory over McNeese State on Monday night. The Wolverines (12-0) are off to their best start since they opened the 2018-19 season 17-0, a school record. It’s just the fourth time Michigan has won its first 12 games. The Cowboys (10-3) had won four straight overall and two consecutive road games before being overmatched by one of college basketball’s top teams. The 24 points matched a career high for Johnson. He also scored 24 this season against Oakland. Yaxel Lendeborg added 16 points for the Wollverines, and Trey McKenney and Aday Mara each had 13. Nimari Burnett scored 12 and Roddy Gayle Jr. finished with 10. Garwey Dual led McNeese State with 15 points. Larry Johnson scored 14, Tyshawn Archie had 12 and DJ Richards Jr. added 11 for the Cowboys. The Wolverines scored the first seven points and led 22-7 before the seven-minute mark of the first half. McNeese State was never able to close the gap to less than 10 the rest of the game. Michigan led 60-29 at halftime. Michigan scored 100 points for the third straight game and sixth time in seven games. The Wolverines have reached the 100-point plateau seven times already this season. That’s three games shy of the school record set in 1988-89. The Wolverines have won nine games this season by 25-plus points and six by 40-plus points. Six of Michigan’s last eight wins were by margins of 30 or more. Up next McNeese State: The Cowboys are home against Lamar on Friday in Southland Conference play. Michigan: The Wolverines host No. 24 USC in a Big Ten game Friday. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here and here (AP News mobile app).
